AXISA8207-VEMkII
AXISA8207-VEMkIINetworkVideoDoorStation
Multifunctional door station for better security solutions
AXIS A8207-VE Mk II Network Video Door Station combines a fully featured 6 MP security camera with high-quality,
two-way audio communication and remote entry control. It also has an integrated RFID multi-frequency reader with
support for most standard credential types including HID® iClass®, allowing you to integrate with other access control
systems. By providing both surveillance and access for visitors and employees, AXIS A8207-VE Mk II increases the
efficiency while keeping down the number of devices at the door. Interaction is intuitive and accessible, with an
induction loop for hearing aids. Analytics, such as motion or sound detection, are supported.
> 6MPwide-anglecamera
> Multiplehardwareinterfaces:audioinput/output,relays,HDMIoutput,RS485
> EasyintegrationwithSIP,VAPIX,andONVIF
> SignedfirmwarewithSecureBoot
> SupportforHID® iClass®
